! Fictitious example configuration - no real device data.
version 17.9
service timestamps debug datetime msec
service timestamps log datetime msec
service password-encryption
!
hostname EXAMPLE-EDGE-01
!
security passwords min-length 12
enable secret 9 $9$EXAMPLEfakeSALT$EXAMPLEfakeHASHvalueNotReal000000000000000
!
aaa new-model
aaa authentication login default local
!
username netadmin privilege 15 secret 9 $9$EXAMPLEfakeSALT$AnotherFakeHashValue111111111111111111111
!
ip domain name example.net
ip ssh version 2
no ip http server
ip http secure-server
!
banner motd ^C
Authorized access only. This banner mentions telnet and password on purpose.
ip http server
^C
!
interface GigabitEthernet0/0
 description WAN uplink (documentation range)
 ip address 192.0.2.1 255.255.255.252
 ip access-group EDGE-IN in
 no ip directed-broadcast
!
interface GigabitEthernet0/1
 description LAN
 ip address 198.51.100.1 255.255.255.0
!
interface GigabitEthernet0/2
 description Spare port
 no ip address
 shutdown
!
interface Loopback0
 ip address 203.0.113.1 255.255.255.255
!
ip access-list standard MGMT-HOSTS
 10 permit 198.51.100.10
 20 deny any log
!
ip access-list extended EDGE-IN
 10 permit tcp any host 192.0.2.1 eq 22
 20 permit icmp any any echo-reply
 30 deny ip any any log
!
access-list 20 permit 198.51.100.20
!
snmp-server community ExampleRO-community-Not-Real RO 20
!
logging host 198.51.100.50
ntp server 198.51.100.123
!
line con 0
 exec-timeout 5 0
 login local
line vty 0 4
 access-class MGMT-HOSTS in
 exec-timeout 10 0
 login local
 transport input ssh
line vty 5 15
 transport input none
!
end
